title: Try out our new and improved app
gist: A promotional page (not an article) for Prospect magazine's relaunched app, whose feature list — digital-only stories, podcasts, queued narrated articles, push notifications, estimated read times and the full digital archive — maps the standard direct-to-consumer playbook legacy print titles are using to move subscribers onto owned channels.

insights.claim: Prospect's app strategy bundles digital-only stories, podcasts, narrated-article playback with queuing, push notifications, estimated read times and the full digital archive, showing a print title competing on audio and habit-formation features rather than text alone.
insights.speaker: Prospect
insights.so_what: Audio and notification-driven retention is now table stakes for subscription publishers — a demand signal for text-to-speech and app-engagement tooling.
insights.locator: Our new app offers a wide variety of new and fantastic features

insights.claim: Access to the app's full feature set is gated behind subscription, with the publisher directing readers to a separate page explaining how to get unrestricted access — the app functions as a subscription-conversion funnel, not a free product.
insights.speaker: Prospect
insights.so_what: Owned apps are being used to reduce platform dependence and raise ARPU per reader — the core economics of the paid-media pivot.
insights.quote: Find out how to enjoy unrestricted access to the app here.

insights.claim: The publisher positions itself as a source of intelligent perspectives on politics, culture, current affairs and world news with expert commentary from leading voices, targeting an ideas-led rather than news-cycle audience.
insights.speaker: Prospect
insights.so_what: Confirms the niche-authority positioning that mid-size ideas publishers rely on to defend pricing against free AI-generated news summaries.
insights.locator: Explore the world of ideas with Prospect magazine’s new app
